title: pocket entry frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter at the top of every pocket entry. Unknown keys are allowed and preserved. The set of valid 'type' values comes from your config, so it is not enumerated here.

id.description: Unique within the knowledge base. Should match the file name without .md.

type.description: One of the entry types defined in your config. The built-in types are library, process, skill, script, pipeline, contract and lesson-learned.

summary.description: One or two sentences. Shown in search results.

version.description: Increased by one each time an approved change is applied.

source.description: Where the knowledge came from: a URL, document or event.

license.description: The license the content is available under, for example Apache-2.0 or CC-BY-4.0.

sourceHash.description: sha256: and the hex digest of the original material this entry was imported from.
